alt: Decision flow: Safe, then Responds, then Breathing normally; yes leads to the recovery position, no leads to calling for help, CPR and an AED.
caption: Safe? Responds? Breathing? Then act

alt: A helper kneels beside a person lying on their back, arms straight and shoulders over interlocked hands on the centre of the chest, pushing 5 to 6 cm at 100 to 120 per minute; an inset shows the heel of the hand on the lower half of the breastbone.
caption: Straight arms, shoulders over hands, push hard

alt: A baby lies on its back on a flat surface while a helper's hands wrap around the chest with both thumbs side by side on the lower half of the breastbone.
caption: Two thumbs on the lower breastbone

alt: Seen from above, a person lies on their side with the top knee bent at a right angle, the top hand under the cheek and the head tilted back so the mouth points down.
caption: On the side, knee bent, mouth down

alt: A bare chest with one AED pad below the person's right collarbone and the other on their left side below the armpit, both wired to the AED.
caption: Right collarbone, left side below armpit

alt: Two panels: a helper supports a choking person leaning forward and strikes between the shoulder blades with the heel of the hand; then stands behind with a fist above the navel and pulls in and up.
caption: 5 back blows, then 5 abdominal thrusts

alt: Two panels: a baby lies face down along the helper's forearm with the head lower than the chest and the jaw supported, receiving back blows; then face up along the forearm, head low, with two fingers pushing on the lower breastbone.
caption: 5 back blows, then 5 chest thrusts

alt: Two hands, one on top of the other, press a cloth firmly down onto a bleeding forearm wound, with red arrows pointing down.
caption: Press hard on the wound, do not lift

alt: A limb with a wound and a tourniquet band with a windlass rod placed 5 to 7 cm above the wound toward the heart, a time tag reading 14:05, and a crossed out band on the joint.
caption: 5 to 7 cm above, never on a joint

alt: Two panels: fingers push gauze from a roll deep into a wound; then two stacked hands press hard on top of the packed wound.
caption: Pack the wound deep, then press hard

alt: Six tiles for BE FAST: B balance, E eyes, F face drooping, A arm drifting down, S slurred speech, T time to call emergency services.
caption: BE FAST: check the signs, call now

alt: A person rests sitting on the floor against a wall with knees bent and brings an aspirin tablet to the mouth to chew it.
caption: Rest with knees bent; chew aspirin if not allergic

alt: A hand presses an adrenaline auto-injector against the outer side of the thigh, through trousers, and holds it there.
caption: Inject into the outer thigh and hold

alt: A person having a seizure lies on a cleared floor with a folded jacket under the head while a helper kneels nearby without holding them; a stopwatch says time it and an object in the mouth is crossed out.
caption: Time it, cushion the head, never restrain

alt: A burned forearm is held under cool running tap water for 20 minutes; ice and butter are crossed out.
caption: Cool running water for 20 minutes

alt: A seated person leans forward and pinches the soft lower part of the nose; tilting the head back is crossed out.
caption: Lean forward and pinch the soft part

alt: A triangular bandage sling holds the injured forearm across the chest with the knot tied at the side of the neck.
caption: Sling supports the forearm across the chest

alt: A person lies flat on their back on a blanket, covered with another blanket, while a kneeling helper reassures them.
caption: Lie flat, keep warm, reassure

alt: Seen from above, a helper kneels at the head of a person lying on their back and holds the head still in line with a hand over each ear.
caption: Hold the head still, in line

alt: A person lies still with the bitten lower leg splinted, marked keep still and go to hospital; tourniquet, cutting, sucking and ice are crossed out.
caption: Keep still, splint the limb, go to hospital

alt: Vinegar is poured from a bottle over tentacle stings on a leg for at least 30 seconds before the tentacles are lifted off.
caption: Vinegar for 30 seconds, then remove tentacles

alt: A person with heat stroke lies in a tub of cold water up to the neck while a kneeling helper holds their head above the water.
caption: Cool fast in cold water to the neck
